subject.title: feat(sqlite): migrate persisted media to canonical facts and stop legacy writes

question: Do maintainers approve requiring operators with pre-v16 agent databases to run `openclaw doctor --fix` before normal runtime access, in exchange for preventing older binaries from silently misreading canonical media facts?
rationale: This is an intentional persisted-data and startup compatibility cutover, not a mechanical implementation choice; repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version changes and upgrade-sensitive behavior.

options.title: Approve the guarded cutover
options.body: Accept v16 as the downgrade guard after reviewing real upgrade evidence and the user-facing Doctor recovery path.

options.title: Keep compatibility temporarily
options.body: Preserve pre-v16 runtime access until the migration can be made non-blocking or the release timing is explicitly scheduled.

options.title: Split migration from enforcement
options.body: Land the idempotent rewrite first and defer the refusing-open guard to a separately approved release change.

recommendation.title: Approve the guarded cutover
recommendation.body: Accept v16 as the downgrade guard after reviewing real upgrade evidence and the user-facing Doctor recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent merged media-facts chain and this proposed migration boundary.
